On the double density spectra of compact spacesThanks:The first author was supported

structure.abstract:
Abstract.The setd​d​(X)dd(X)of densities ofalldense subspaces of a topological spaceXXis
called thedouble density spectrumofXX. In this note we present a couple of
results that implyλ∈d​d​(X)\lambda\in dd(X), provided thatXXis acompactspace
andλ\lambdais a cardinal satisfying certain conditions.As a consequence of these results, we prove thatd​d​(X)=[d⁡(X),w⁡(X)]dd(X)=[d(X),w(X)]holds for any polyadic spaceXX.
This, in turn, implies thatd​d​(G)=[d⁡(G),w⁡(G)]dd(G)=[d(G),w(G)]for any
locally compact topological groupGG.
